lessons.trilhas-vento.title: Pheromones and wind
lessons.trilhas-vento.question: Does wind change workers’ trails and local choices?
lessons.trilhas-vento.setup: A prepared colony and an artificial initial chemical trail, identical in A/B. Wind also affects air; the experiment does not isolate chemistry alone.
lessons.repouso-solo.title: Angle of repose
lessons.repouso-solo.question: Does the same loose soil slide differently?
lessons.repouso-solo.setup: An identical disturbance prepares loose material in both worlds. The angle is an exploratory parameter, not calibrated soil.
lessons.entradas-ar.title: Entrances and ventilation
lessons.entradas-ar.question: How does an opening change O₂ and CO₂ in the galleries?
lessons.entradas-ar.setup: A teaching nest with controlled geometry and identical initial air concentrations. Opening the second access also changes its segment and volume.
lessons.crias-temperatura.title: Brood in cold and warmth
lessons.crias-temperatura.question: How does temperature affect thermal accumulation in the same brood?
lessons.crias-temperatura.setup: Prepared eggs, identical soil water and a generic thermal profile without diapause. This is not a calibrated species.
lessons.fundacao-coleta.title: Two founding strategies
lessons.fundacao-coleta.question: What changes when the queen can forage outside?
lessons.fundacao-coleta.setup: Two alates and intact soil. Compares strategy profiles: entrance/sealing and foraging also change; this is not a comparison between species.
lessons.mesma-seed.title: Same seed, one intervention
lessons.mesma-seed.question: Can a localized intervention separate two futures from the same seed?
lessons.mesma-seed.setup: Identical initial worlds; only B receives food through the normal intervention mechanism at the initial time.
lessons.heranca.title: Inheritance and movement
lessons.heranca.question: How does a maternal locomotion allele reach daughters and affect movement?
lessons.heranca.setup: A prepared family. Changes one queen locus; the father and other genes remain identical. Genetic effects are demonstrations, not real DNA.
